violation_type.title: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training (26 TAC §744.2105(2))
violation_type.short_title: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training
violation_type.typical_finding: Caregivers confirmed that children were not provided a snack due to the students' poor behavior.     The deficiency was corrected as the director and inspector discussed the matter with the staff members.    Children were also observed being served a snack shortly after this discussion.

finding_variants.text: Caregivers confirmed that children were not provided a snack due to the students' poor behavior.     The deficiency was corrected as the director and inspector discussed the matter with the staff members.    Children were also observed being served a snack shortly after this discussion.

Caregiver stated to children " if you are not going to listen you will not get a cup cake." Caregiver stated to a child, "child name you are not getting a cup cake and I going to tell your mom and TiTi."
It was determined that a caregiver kept food from children as a punishment.
